description: This file defines the WifiChannel class within the beerocks namespace, representing WiFi channel properties such as channel number, frequency, bandwidth, and related attributes. It includes constructors, getters, setters, and utility methods for handling WiFi channel data.

classes.name: WifiChannel
classes.description: Represents a WiFi channel with properties like channel number, frequency, bandwidth, and extension details. Provides methods for constructing, copying, and querying channel attributes.

methods.name: WifiChannel
methods.description: Default constructor for an empty WifiChannel object.

methods.name: WifiChannel
methods.description: Constructor initializing WifiChannel with specific parameters: channel, frequency, bandwidth, and extension above secondary.

methods.name: WifiChannel
methods.description: Constructor initializing WifiChannel with specific parameters: channel, frequency type, bandwidth, and extension above secondary.

methods.name: WifiChannel
methods.description: Copy constructor creating a new WifiChannel from an existing one.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator copying data from another WifiChannel.

methods.name: get_channel
methods.description: Returns the primary channel number.

methods.name: set_channel
methods.description: Sets a new channel number and updates center frequency accordingly.

methods.name: get_center_frequency
methods.description: Returns the center frequency of the channel.

methods.name: get_center_frequency_2
methods.description: Returns the center frequency for 160MHz bandwidth in 6GHz band, or 0 if not applicable.

methods.name: get_bandwidth
methods.description: Returns the bandwidth of the channel.

methods.name: set_bandwidth
methods.description: Sets the bandwidth of the channel.

methods.name: get_freq_type
methods.description: Returns the frequency type (2.4GHz, 5GHz, 6GHz).

methods.name: get_ext_above_primary
methods.description: Returns extension above primary channel: 1, 0, or -1.

methods.name: get_ext_above_secondary
methods.description: Returns whether the secondary channel is above primary.

methods.name: is_empty
methods.description: Checks if the WifiChannel object is uninitialized or default.

methods.name: is_dfs_channel
methods.description: Checks if the channel is a DFS channel (only for 5GHz).

methods.name: get_tx_power
methods.description: Returns the transmit power.

methods.name: set_tx_power
methods.description: Sets the transmit power.

methods.name: get_radar_affected
methods.description: Returns whether the channel is affected by radar.

methods.name: set_radar_affected
methods.description: Sets the radar affected status.
